notes: Relevance requires ALL of: chunk source in expected_source (null = any, list = any of them), chunk's deepest header matches expected_section, and expected_phrase appears in the chunk text. Phrases are verified present in the raw guide AND all three emoji modes, so corpus A/Bs stay fair. The two hybrid guides share whole sections verbatim (Opener, Melee Phase, Defensive Usage), so those questions list both as acceptable sources. expected_section null means no guide can answer it and the model must refuse.

questions.question: Which familiar should I use below 2500% enrage with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Below 2500% enrage, swap to the Ripper Demon familiar.

questions.question: Can I kill Arch-Glacor on a Slayer task?
questions.expected_answer: No. Arch-Glacor is not affected by Slayer tasks in hard mode.

questions.question: What enrage range is the Necromancy guide aimed at?
questions.expected_answer: The guide targets 2500%-4000% enrage, though the information applies at lower enrage too.

questions.question: How many stacks of Kwuarm incense should I have with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Kwuarm incense should be at 4 stacks.

questions.question: Which sigil do I need unlocked for this preset with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: The Limitless Sigil should be unlocked.

questions.question: What does Powder of Penance replace in the preset with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Powder of Penance is optional and replaces the blessed flask, at increased cost.

questions.question: What is the full opening sequence for Arch-Glacor with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Darkness (cast outside) then Invoke Death, Conjure Undead Army, Life Transfer, Command Vengeful Ghost, Command Skeleton Warrior, and Bloat.

questions.question: Which ability should I attack with first, and why with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Bloat. It is a low adrenaline investment with no cooldown and high use priority, and there is a 2/5 chance the first mechanic (minions or exposed core) nullifies your opening attacks.

questions.question: Which abilities should I keep upkept throughout the fight with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Aim to upkeep Bloat and Conjure Undead Army as much as possible.

questions.question: What should I save Split Soul for at 3500% enrage and above with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: At 3500%+ enrage, always reserve Split Soul for the exposed core.

questions.question: When is the best time to use Living Death with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: During the flurry mechanic, which gives a long uninterrupted damage window. It can situationally be used to reset Death Skulls in anticipation of an upcoming exposed core.

questions.question: Should I reserve Living Death for the arms phase with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: No. Living Death should not be strategically reserved for arms, because the time to clear the mechanic does not change much with or without the ultimate active.

questions.question: Which abilities should I put on cooldown before the pillars of ice mechanic with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Death Guard Essence of Finality special attack, Touch of Death, and Divert, because pillars blocks line of sight.

questions.question: How many Necrosis stacks and Residual Souls should I hold for the exposed core?
questions.expected_answer: Hold at least 4 Necrosis stacks and at least 2 Residual Souls for the exposed core.

questions.question: When should I wear TFN gear with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: When the exposed core is active, when pillars of ice is active, when Disruption Shield, Devotion or Barricade is active, before casting Conjure Undead Army, and when Arch-Glacor is not casting autos and you are at or below your max HP in DPS gear (~11,100).

questions.question: When should I wear tank gear with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Tank gear should always be worn whenever you are taking damage, outside of the situations that call for TFN.

questions.question: Which auto attacks do the most damage during flurry, and why with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Ranged autos, because the 3-piece Cryptbloom buff does not reduce ranged damage.

questions.question: What is the arms rotation at 3000% enrage with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Invoke Death, Split Soul, threshold cycle Vulnerability bomb with Bloat, Death Skulls, Command Skeleton Warrior, Soul Strike until 0 stacks, Death Guard EoF special, Command Putrid Zombie, Command Phantom Guardian, Devotion, Omni Guard special attack.

questions.question: What is the arms rotation below 2500% enrage with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Invoke Death, then Soul Strike, then Soul Strike.

questions.question: When can I swap to tank gear during the exposed core with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Around 15 seconds into the exposed core, to benefit from the 3-piece Cryptbloom magic damage reduction passive.

questions.question: How do I get to 100% adrenaline if I need to Barricade during arms with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Use Divert and flick to Soul Split for one tick to reach 100% adrenaline.

questions.question: What should I use during arms if I only have 1 or 2 Residual Soul stacks with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Use Soul Strike instead of Volley of Souls when starting with low (1-2) Residual Soul stacks.

questions.question: Where should I stand if I am flanking during arms with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Stand central or on the south wall next to the boss.

questions.question: What is the glacyte minion rotation below 2500% enrage with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Invoke Death, Threads of Fate, Soul Sap, Volley of Souls.

questions.question: What is the glacyte minion rotation at 3000% enrage with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Soul Sap, Spectral Scythe, Invoke Death, Threads of Fate, Volley of Souls, Soul Sap, Volley of Souls, Spectral Scythe 2nd hit, Spectral Scythe 3rd hit, Soul Sap, then Spectral Scythe or Volley of Souls.

questions.question: Which glacyte should I target when clearing minions with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Always target the bolstering glacyte, which causes perks and the Jas book to activate on it.

questions.question: Where should I throw the Vulnerability bomb during minions with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: On the magic minion closest to the bolstering glacyte, which applies vulnerability to all five glacytes.

questions.question: How many Residual Soul stacks do I need before casting Volley of Souls with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: 5 Residual Soul stacks.

questions.question: What happens at 10 stacks of freezing blood with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: 10 stacks of freezing blood applies a 3 second bind and stun.

questions.question: Should I cast Spectral Scythe before or after Invoke Death when clearing minions with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Before. Casting Spectral Scythe first starts its 15 second cooldown, so it is available again before the third Volley of Souls.

questions.question: What defensives should I use for the frost cannon with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Anticipation, then Vengeance with Soul Split and Reflect, then Reprisal with Powerburst of Vitality, in tank gear at max HP.

questions.question: What gear should I wear for the frost cannon with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Always wear tank gear for the frost cannon mechanic.

questions.question: What defensives should I use during flurry with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Disruption Shield or Reflect, then Divert, then Debilitate if needed.

questions.question: How much damage does Divert deal at 4000% enrage with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Divert deals roughly 27k damage at 4000% enrage.

questions.question: What should I do during the pillars of ice mechanic with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Life Transfer, Anticipation, Preparation, Command Skeleton Warrior.

questions.question: Can my skeleton deal damage if I have no line of sight with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. Command Skeleton Warrior can deal damage even without line of sight, depending on the skeleton's position.

questions.question: Is there an example kill video at 4000% enrage with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, a 10:57 kill at 4000%: https://youtu.be/ETA6vtiuOvA?si=ZYkp-da10MvEuS0d

questions.question: Do you have a video of a GM timer kill with Necromancy?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, a 3000% GM timer kill in 5:25: https://youtu.be/B-5v0Qb4XUE?si=I57326aSERYg8Cub

questions.question: What should I use during Pillars of Ice as a hybrid?
